ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. AO undergrad tuition rate is $304 per credit hour and all students are assessed a $50 per credit hour administration fee. This section is for nonresidential, undergraduate, nondegree off-campus students only, on-campus students should register for the on-campus section. This is an accelerated 8 week course and may require more time commitment per week than a traditional 16 week course. Note: For registration questions, please contact the Peggy Day (Office of Continuing Education), at pcday@illinois.edu
